'''Groat cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] made from [[groat]] [[Groat milk|milk]]. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] had an aroma reminiscent of putrefying groat cheese.
